label: iPhone 15 smartphone
description: Apple iPhone 15 — 6.1-inch smartphone with Wi-Fi 6 and 5G sub-6/mmWave, now with a USB-C port that supports USB-C to Ethernet adapters.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — the non-Pro iPhone 15 did not move to 6E. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave on US models. USB-C is USB 2.0 (480 Mbps) and supports USB-C Ethernet adapters (iOS 17+), so usb0 is modelled at 1G but a real dock NIC negotiates at ~100M; note this when testing tether-over-cable throughput.
